d:
Suman realises that good packaging and a brand identity are just as important as the quality of the achaar. Convinced, she decides to invest all her savings in branding and packaging. But will this big investment finally help her achaar business take off, or will it put everything she has worked for at risk?
Watch Ep4 to find out!
Stay tuned for Episode 5!
Credits:
Directed by: Apoorv Singh Karki
Produced by: Arunabh Kumar
Created by: Arunabh Kumar & Apoorv Singh Karki
Executive Producer: Shreyansh Pandey, Vijay Koshy
